title: Train a linear model
hints: Each epoch is: predict, take the residual, compute both gradients, step both parameters. Record the loss before the step.
With a bias, y_hat = X @ w + b. dL/dw = (2/N) * X.T @ r as before, and dL/db = (2/N) * sum(r).
R squared is 1 - SS_res / SS_tot, where SS_tot is measured around the mean of y. A model that always predicts the mean scores 0.

wrong.loss_after_step.py: history records the loss after the step, so history[0] is not the starting loss
wrong.r2_uncentered.py: R squared divides by mean(y**2) instead of the variance
